name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The single hard Absence(key_lost) matches the task exactly. The environment defines key_lost as the event where has_door_key turns false while door_open is false, so the 'while the door is still closed' condition is already built into the event, and the ban maps to a plain Absence(key_lost) with no Precedence needed. Dropping the key after the door is open fires no key_lost (as in the example trace at step 19), which is exactly what the task permits. The wording 'Don't drop...' is a categorical prohibition with no preference cue, so hard is the right priority, and the clause is satisfiable in this environment (pick up the ball before the key, or open the door before dropping the key). The task is a pure restriction with no unconditionally commanded event, so the empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are valid, and the machine (u0 -> u1 on key_lost, u1 rejecting, -10) correctly implements a hard Absence.

texts: Never lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
